app.name: Satchel
app.tagline: Leave your phone in flight mode. Satchel still works.

trips.settingsHint: Opens haptics, motion and privacy settings
next.title: Next up

trip.addHint: Choose what kind of booking to add

tripEdit.err.homeTz: Time zone not recognised. Use a name like Australia/Sydney.

itemEdit.name: Title
itemEdit.tzHint: Times are as printed on the ticket, in that place's local time.

itemEdit.err.endBeforeStart: It ends before it starts. Check the dates, times and time zones.
itemEdit.err.endRequired: Add when it ends (arrival, check-out or drop-off).
map.title: Map
map.soon: The map arrives in a coming build
map.soonBody: Your bookings and saved places will be pinned here, with toilets, water, food and pharmacies nearby.
wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.emptyBody: Tickets you attach to a trip show here in time order, ready to open at full brightness.
emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.emptyBody: Local emergency numbers, your insurance and emergency contacts, one tap away even in flight mode.
trip.title: Trip
item.title: Booking
essentials.title: Essentials
essentials.body: Next ticket, hotel address and emergency card on a plain black screen.
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Data Not Collected. Satchel has no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Your trips, tickets and documents stay on this phone.
ticket.filesEmptyBody: Add a ticket or travel document from Files or Photos.
ticket.chooseFileHint: Selects a PDF or image from Files
ticket.removeHint: Removes this file from the booking
ticket.removeBody: The copy saved in Satchel is deleted from this phone. The original in Files or Photos is not touched.
ticket.qrHint: Choose the ticket image in Photos, then fit the square around the QR code or barcode
ticket.qrEmptyBody: Save a crop of the QR code and it opens big, in one tap, at the gate.
ticket.err.add: File wasn’t added. Satchel couldn’t read this file. Choose it again from Files or Photos.
ticket.err.unsupported: File type not supported. Choose a PDF or image file.
ticket.err.save: File wasn’t saved. There may not be enough storage on this phone. Free up space and try again.
ticket.err.qr: QR image couldn’t be added. Choose a clear image of the code and try again.
ticket.err.photosDenied: Photos access is off. Allow access in Settings, or choose the file from Files instead.
ticket.imageHint: Double tap to switch between fit and fill
ticket.pdfBody: Open the PDF to show it full screen. Save a QR crop from a screenshot of it and the code opens here in one tap.
ticket.openPdfHint: Opens the system share sheet with {name}
ticket.missing: This file is no longer on this phone
ticket.missingBody: It may have been removed. Remove it from the booking, or add it again from Files or Photos.
ticket.brokenBody: The file may be damaged. Remove it from the booking and add it again.
ticket.noneBody: Add a ticket or attach a file to the booking to keep it handy here.
ticket.manageHint: Returns to the booking to add or remove files
ticket.brightnessOff: Turn up the brightness for scanning.
wallet.openHint: Opens the ticket at full brightness
emergency.countryNoneBody: Pick a country to see its emergency numbers. Satchel never checks your location for this.
emergency.countryGuessPhone: Guessed from your phone's time zone ({city})
emergency.countryChangeHint: Shows a searchable list of countries
emergency.countrySearchPlaceholder: Country name or code, like JP
emergency.countryUseTripHint: Goes back to guessing the country from your trip
emergency.countryMore: Showing {n} of {total}. Type to narrow the list.
emergency.callHint: Opens your phone's call screen. You confirm before it dials.
emergency.noNumber: No confirmed number. Ask your hotel or embassy.
emergency.verifyLocally: Verify locally. Numbers can change, so check with your hotel, a local official source or your embassy.
emergency.sourcePending: Source pending. This bundled number has not yet been checked against an official source.
emergency.contactsEmptyBody: Add someone you can contact while travelling.
emergency.medicalPrivate: Private. Stored only on this phone.
emergency.medicalShowHint: Reveals your private medical notes on screen
emergency.cardEmptyBody: Save contacts, insurance details and any medical notes you may need.
emergency.freeForever: The emergency card is free and works with no signal.
emergency.callUnavailableBody: This device couldn't open a call for {number}. Dial it from a phone, or ask someone nearby to call.
emergency.callInvalid: This number can't be dialled. Check it in Edit emergency card.
emergency.edit.addContactHint: Adds a blank emergency contact to fill in
emergency.edit.pickContactHint: Opens your phone's contact picker to add one person
emergency.edit.medicalPrivate: Medical notes stay on this phone. They are never sent anywhere.
emergency.edit.errName: Add a name for this contact.
emergency.edit.errPhone: Enter a phone number with digits, like +61 400 000 000.
emergency.contacts.permBody: Allow Contacts access in Settings, or add the emergency contact details yourself.
emergency.contacts.unavailableBody: The contact picker isn't available here. Type the contact's name and phone instead.
emergency.contacts.noPhoneBody: {name} has no phone number saved. Add one below.
emergency.contacts.error: Couldn't read that contact. Type the details instead.
address.callPlaceHint: Opens your phone's call screen. You confirm before it dials.
address.noAddressBody: Add the address so you can show it to a driver. Adding the local-language address too makes it easiest to read.
address.editBookingHint: Opens this booking to add the address
address.notFound: This booking is no longer on this phone.
address.showHint: Shows the address in large text to show a driver
address.copyTip: Press and hold the address to copy it.
vault.title: Document vault
vault.privacy: Your document copies are stored only on this phone.
vault.footer: Documents stay on this device. Satchel has no account and no server.
vault.lockedBody: Unlock to see your saved passport, visa and licence copies.
vault.unlock.hint: Uses device authentication to open your saved documents.
vault.unlockingBody: Use Face ID or your device passcode to continue.
vault.err.unlockBody: Face ID or your device passcode didn’t unlock the vault. Try again.
vault.err.noLockBody: This phone can’t lock the vault right now. Turn on Face ID or set a device passcode in Settings to protect your documents.
vault.openUnlockedHint: Opens the vault unprotected. Anyone holding this phone could see your documents.
vault.unprotected: The vault is open without a lock. Set a device passcode in Settings to protect your documents.
vault.lockNowHint: Hides your documents until you unlock again
vault.emptyBody: Add a document to keep a local copy here.
vault.addHint: Adds a document stored on this device.
vault.slot.title: Documents
vault.slot.none: Keep passport, visa and licence copies here, locked with Face ID.
vault.slot.trip: Check your documents before your next trip
doc.warn.sixMonths: Reminder: {doc} expires on {date}, less than 6 months after {trip} ends. Many countries require 6 months’ validity — check your destination’s rule.
doc.notFound: This document is no longer on this phone.
doc.label: Name
doc.noCopies: No copy saved. Edit the document to add a photo or PDF.
doc.openPdfHint: Shows the PDF in the system viewer
doc.openFailed: This file couldn’t be opened on this phone.
doc.missingFile: The saved file for {name} is missing. Edit the document to add it again.
doc.deleteConfirm: Delete {label} and its saved copies from this phone?
doc.err.label: Give the document a name.
doc.err.expires: Expiry date must be a real date like 2031-05-14, or left empty.
doc.addPhotoHint: Choose a photo of the document. It is copied onto this phone.
doc.addFileHint: Choose a PDF or image. It is copied onto this phone.
doc.removeCopyHint: Removes this copy when you save
doc.err.pickDenied: Photos access is off. Allow access in Settings, or add the copy from Files.
doc.err.pick: That file couldn’t be added. Try again or choose a different file.
doc.discardConfirm: Discard your changes to this document?
packing.title: Packing list
packing.notFound: This trip isn’t on this device any more.
packing.templateHint: Choose one or more trip types for suggested items. You can edit the list afterwards.
packing.useTemplatesHint: Adds the suggested items for the chosen trip types.
packing.startEmptyHint: Creates an empty list you can add items to.
packing.emptyBody: Add items below to start packing.
packing.addHint: Adds an item to this packing list.
packing.itemPlaceholder: What do you need to pack?
packing.errorEmpty: Type a name for the item.
packing.errorDuplicate: That item is already on your list.
packing.hintUnpack: Marks this item as not packed
packing.removeHint: Removes this item from the list.
packing.resetHint: Marks every item as not packed, without removing any.
packing.resetBody: Every item will be marked as not packed. Nothing is removed.
packing.resetDone: All items marked as not packed
